verdict.rationale: The evidence pack contains no PCIe generation/lane counts, no storage interface specs, and no external connectivity (USB/Thunderbolt/display) documentation for the Snapdragon X2 Elite Extreme; the vendor page instead covers CPU cores, NPU TOPS, and memory bandwidth, and explicitly notes gaps like missing TDP and memory capacity. Community discussion also only questions benchmarks/thermals, not I/O specs. Missing for 10: PCIe generation and lane count, storage/NVMe interface specs, USB/Thunderbolt/display connectivity specs, any dock-compatibility guidance.
